info.title: Source Engine Server List API
info.description: Counter-Strike: Source discovery, live snapshots, durable abuse enforcement, evidence, and recovery.

get.summary: Get a fresh eligible player roster

get.description: Whole-IP entries use port zero. Active per-server durable bans use their nonzero server port. Invalid legacy addresses are omitted.

get.summary: Get the public blacklist entry count
get.description: Counts the valid whole-IP and active per-server entries included in the downloadable blacklist.

post.description: The same UUID and address replay the stored result, including the originally resolved country. Reusing the UUID for a different intent returns 409.
Creates durable manual authority. A same-key retry returns the stored result. Historical-only reasons are readable but cannot be written.
Clears active strike state and compatibility state while preserving evidence and enforcement history. If the server row no longer exists, requires_repopulation is true.

Targets the blacklist row captured by the operation receipt. Linked enforcement contributors determine which tracker bans and states are cleared. Manual and legacy server bans remain active. Deleted server rows require a complete fetch or manual add to repopulate.

get.description: Returns private review notes ordered by updated_at DESC, id DESC. The default limit is 50 and the maximum is 200. Pass a nonempty next_cursor back unchanged.

post.description: Creates or replaces the exact endpoint's current exclusion. The form accepts exactly one address, excluded_players, reason, and review_note value; unknown, duplicate, and empty values are rejected. The endpoint must currently exist. Same-key retries replay the durable result, including terminal target_not_found.

404.description: Durable target_not_found result. Replaying the same key returns the same result even after rediscovery.

post.description: Clears the exact endpoint's adjustment even when its game-server row is absent. The form accepts exactly one address and review_note value; unknown, duplicate, and empty values are rejected. Same-key retries replay the durable result.

get.description: Ordered by observed_at DESC, id DESC. Pass next_cursor unchanged to fetch the next page.
Groups legacy server bans and event-unlinked legacy blacklists by their persisted reason.

200.description: Authoritative membership and a usable snapshot are available

503.description: Startup, membership, or snapshot state is not ready

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A canonical lowercase UUID retained for this user intent and reused for transport or unknown-outcome retries.

BadRequest.description: Malformed address, filter, reason, limit, cursor, or idempotency key

Conflict.description: The idempotency key belongs to another intent, or current durable policy rejects the request

NotFound.description: The requested server or eligible roster does not exist

MembershipUnavailable.description: Tracker membership is unavailable, or an indeterminate mutation returns its operation key, retry_same_key=true, and unknown_membership_converged or unknown_membership_degraded

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid HTTP Basic credentials. The response has no body.

MembershipStarting.description: Administrative routes are unavailable until authoritative membership is ready.

SnapshotUnavailable.description: Membership is degraded or no usable public snapshot exists

MutationResult.description: Durable mutation result with attempt-local publication_status. A known commit remains successful when publication_status is committed_membership_degraded. A same-key retry returns the same operation identity and domain result.

RecoveryResult.description: Durable recovery result with outcome, operation ID, replay status, event IDs, requires_repopulation, and attempt-local publication_status.

PopulationAdjustmentListBadRequest.description: The limit or cursor is malformed.

PopulationAdjustmentListFailure.description: The current population adjustments could not be loaded.

PopulationAdjustmentBadRequest.description: The form, address, adjustment values, review note, or idempotency key is invalid.

PopulationAdjustmentConflict.description: The idempotency key belongs to a different normalized population-adjustment intent.

PopulationAdjustmentFailure.description: A pending durable intent must be retried with the same key, no receipt was created, or durable receipt integrity requires operator intervention.

PopulationAdjustmentUnavailable.description: Membership is not ready, or receipt creation or domain commit is inconclusive.
